title: WETW: Learning Pair-Specific Weighted Euclidean Distances for Efficient DTW Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.17412v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is the standard distance for similarity search over time series that are misaligned in time, but its cost is quadratic in the series length and lower bounds often prune few candidates, so search over large collections of long series is slow. Learned approximations embed the series to make comparisons cheap, yet compare every pair with the same fixed rule, usually the Euclidean distance, although DTW aligns each pair differently. We observe that, once a pair is aligned, DTW is a Euclidean distance over coordinates selected for that pair. Building on this view, we propose Weighted Euclidean Time Warping (WETW), a learned distance that adapts the comparison of fixed-length embeddings to each pair. A small symmetric network predicts one weight per embedding di- mension and pair without computing an alignment, which halves the error of the best static distance on the same embeddings. translated_title: WETW：学习针对特定序列对的加权欧几里得距离以实现高效DTW搜索
translated_abstract: 动态时间规整（DTW）是对时间上错位的时间序列进行相似性搜索的标准距离度量，但其计算成本与序列长度呈二次方关系，且下界通常只能剪枝掉很少的候选序列，因此在大规模长序列集合上的搜索速度很慢。学习型近似方法将序列嵌入到向量空间以降低比较成本，但它们对每一对序列都使用相同的固定规则进行比较（通常是欧几里得距离），而实际上DTW对每一对序列的对齐方式都不相同。我们观察到，一旦一对序列被对齐，DTW实际上就是在为该对序列所选坐标上计算的欧几里得距离。基于这一观点，我们提出了加权欧几里得时间规整（WETW），这是一种学习型距离，能够针对每一对序列自适应地调整固定长度嵌入的比较方式。一个小型对称网络在无需计算对齐的情况下，为每个嵌入维度和每对序列预测一个权重，这使得在同一嵌入上的误差相比最佳静态距离减半。这些嵌入来自W……
tldr: 提出WETW学习型距离，利用小型对称网络为每对序列的每个嵌入维度预测权重，实现针对特定序列对的自适应比较且无需计算对齐，将误差相比最佳静态距离减半，从而实现高效的DTW相似性搜索。
en_tdlr: WETW is a learned distance that uses a small symmetric network to predict pair-specific weights for each embedding dimension without computing alignments, adapting comparisons to each pair and halving the error of the best static distance for efficient DTW search.
